thread:
sam.design: Quick thought - I put a tiny prototype for the prompt-sets detail view where the diff pane has a compact metadata header (prompt name, run id, tags, token delta). Can we sanity-check?

maria.pm: link?

sam.design: https://redwood/intern/prototypes/prompt-evals/meta-header-v1. Idea: metadata sticky above diff so reviewers keep context.

devon.frontend: looks good. dev notes: keep j/k navigation stable, compute token delta client-side if API lacks it, avoid layout jumps when diffs load.

alex.research: token delta is great for quick triage. please expose it in header like "tokens: +3".

li.accessibility: a11y: add an aria-live region announcing "Showing diff for <prompt>, tokens changed: +N" when selection changes; buttons need aria-pressed and text labels (no color only). Also ensure focus ring visible on Mac Safari (recommend 3px outline fallback).

maria.pm: copy: current CTAs are "Approve change" / "Reject". Legal hates "Reject". Suggestion: "Mark expected" / "Mark regression" — explicit and domain-relevant.

devon.frontend: agree. will implement copy change, tooltip "Mark expected — change matches desired behavior", keyboard shortcuts m = expected, r = regression, shift+m bulk. Add toast undo (5s) and bulk confirm for >50 items.

qa-bot: Run 3499 complete : 7 regressions queued for triage.

sam.design: action items: devon to open PR with screenshots + keyboard test notes, li to review a11y on PR, maria to finalize tooltip copy. Target: Friday PR.

devon.frontend: will ship Friday EOD.

sam.design: thanks all :thumbsup:
